challenges.title: Sum an Array
challenges.prompt: Write a function `sumArray(nums)` that returns the **sum** of all numbers in the array `nums`. An empty array should return `0`.

challenges.title: Reverse a String
challenges.prompt: Write `reverse(str)` that returns the characters of `str` in reverse order. `reverse("abc")` should return `"cba"`.

challenges.title: FizzBuzz
challenges.prompt: Write `fizzbuzz(n)` that returns an **array** of length `n`. For each number `1..n`: use `"Fizz"` if divisible by 3, `"Buzz"` if divisible by 5, `"FizzBuzz"` if divisible by both, otherwise the number itself (as a number, not a string).

challenges.title: Count the Vowels
challenges.prompt: Write `countVowels(str)` that returns how many vowels (`a`, `e`, `i`, `o`, `u`, case-insensitive) appear in `str`.

challenges.title: Palindrome Check
challenges.prompt: Write `isPalindrome(str)` that returns `true` if `str` reads the same forwards and backwards, ignoring case and spaces. `"Race car"` is a palindrome.

challenges.title: Two Sum
challenges.prompt: Write `twoSum(nums, target)` that returns the **indices** of the two numbers in `nums` that add up to `target`, as an array `[i, j]` with `i < j`. Exactly one solution exists, and you may not use the same element twice. `twoSum([2, 7, 11, 15], 9)` returns `[0, 1]`.

challenges.title: Greet by Name
challenges.prompt: Write a function `greet(name)` that returns the string `"Hello, <name>!"` — for example `greet("Ada")` returns `"Hello, Ada!"`.

challenges.title: Sum a List
challenges.prompt: Write `sum_list(nums)` that returns the sum of all numbers in the list `nums`. An empty list returns `0`.

challenges.title: Count the Evens
challenges.prompt: Write `count_evens(nums)` that returns how many numbers in the list `nums` are even.

challenges.title: FizzBuzz (Python)
challenges.prompt: Write `fizzbuzz(n)` that returns a list of length `n`. For each number `1..n`: `"Fizz"` if divisible by 3, `"Buzz"` if divisible by 5, `"FizzBuzz"` if divisible by both, otherwise the number itself (as an int).
